detail: Python byte-diff script compared pre-migration backups (C:/tmp/verify_root, C:/tmp/verify_memapi) against migrated history.ndjson line-by-line for both stores: 2997 + 1086 lines changed, 0 unexpected mismatches (every changed line differs only in the `"state":"new"/"ready"` token -> `"state":"open"/"planned"`; all other bytes, key order, and line ordering identical). No JSON re-serialization was used; migration is a targeted regex substring substitution.
